reason: Provides HTTP fetching tools for webpage text and JSON APIs with User-Agent rotation, retry handling, anti-bot response detection, and adaptive site-level rate limiting; human review is warranted because the documented features facilitate anti-bot evasion and automated collection.

summaries.zh: 用于抓取网页文本和 JSON API 数据的 HTTP 工具插件，提供 User-Agent 轮换、失败重试、反爬响应检测和站点级自适应限流。
summaries.en: An HTTP utility plugin for fetching webpage text and JSON API data with User-Agent rotation, retry handling, anti-bot response detection, and site-level adaptive rate limiting.

capabilities: Outbound HTTP GET requests to websites and JSON APIs
Detection of CAPTCHA, challenge, and other anti-bot responses
Webpage text extraction and JSON parsing
